title: Transcript of the lifted tester
statement: Let $T$ be a finite-seed randomized nonadaptive tester making $r$ queries to functions from $\{\pm1\}^N$ to $\{\pm1\}$. For any nonnegative integer $n$, Boolean string $w\in\{0,1\}^n$, Boolean proof table $p\colon\{0,1,\ldots,2^N-1\}\to\{0,1\}$, and seed of $T$, converting each answer in the lifted tester's transcript on the concatenated input $(w,p)$ from a Boolean value to a sign gives exactly the transcript of $T$ on the sign-valued function on the sign cube encoded by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive tester with finite seed space, making r queries from the sign cube of dimension N and returning signs
A Boolean string w of length n
A Boolean proof table on 2^N entries
